issues.title: Ingest Logan County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $19,600,031 across 32 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($5,952,260), County Road Fund ($3,190,449), Emergency Medical Service Fund ($2,387,045). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
